Definition: Unni, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Unni is the name of two Israelites, a Levite musician and a gatekeeper of the temple. In 1 Chronicles 15:18, Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah. The fuller story is told on the Unni profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Unni is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
